entities.name: Samanid Empire
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: Samanid Empire, a political institution in Tajikistan during Arab Conquest and Samanid Golden Age (819–999). Grew from Muslim and Arab Conquest and Islamization. Led to the emergence of Arab and Rudaki, the 'father of Persian poetry,' composes at the Samanid court in Bukhara.
